in_marathi.name: Bhanuja
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhanuja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhanu’, meaning ‘Sun’. The name ‘Bhanuja’ is a tribute to the deity of the Sun. In Hindu mythology, the Sun god is believed to bestow power, strength, and prosperity upon his devotees.
